question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH region_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        COUNT(o.id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps s ON s.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
    GROUP BY r.name
),
rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        s.id AS sales_rep_id,
        s.name AS sales_rep_name,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps s ON s.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
    GROUP BY r.name, s.id, s.name
),
max_per_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        MAX(rep_total_sales) AS max_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.num_orders,
    rs.total_sales,
    rep.sales_rep_name,
    rep.rep_total_sales
FROM region_stats rs
JOIN max_per_region mpr ON rs.region_name = mpr.region_name
JOIN rep_sales rep ON rep.region_name = mpr.region_name AND rep.rep_total_sales = mpr.max_sales
ORDER BY rs.region_name, rep.sales_rep_name
